header.running_head: Loving a Muslim for the Pleasure of Allaah

blocks.text: Rasulullaah ﷺ's Love for Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)

Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ was once asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Whom do you love most?" "Aa'isha," came the reply. "And from amongst the men?" the question came. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Abu Bakr." "Whom then?" was the next question. "Then it is Abu Ubaydah," said Rasulullaah ﷺ.[^1]

Hadhrat Amr (RA) narrates that he once asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Which person do you love most?" When Rasulullaah ﷺ replied that it was Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) that he loved most, Hadhrat Amr (RA) said, "I am asking about men." "Her father (Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA))," was the reply.[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Tells the Sahabah (RA) to Inform the Person they Liked Solely for the Pleasure of Allaah that they Liked him

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that a Sahabi (RA) was once sitting with Rasulullaah ﷺ when another passed by. "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" the Sahabi (RA) said, "I really like that man." "Have you informed him about it?" Rasulullaah ﷺ enquired. When the Sahabi (RA) replied that he had not, Rasulullaah ﷺ told him to do so. The Sahabi (RA) then met the man and said to him, "I like you for the pleasure of Allaah." The other responded by saying:
"May the One (Allaah) for Whose pleasure you like me, also like you."[^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) says, "I was once sitting with Rasulullaah ﷺ when a man arrived. He greeted Rasulullaah ﷺ and then left. I then said to Rasulullaah ﷺ, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I really like that man.' 'Have you informed him about it?' Rasulullaah ﷺ enquired. When I replied that I had not, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'Then inform your brother about it.' I then went up to him, greeted him and holding his shoulder, I said, 'By Allaah! I like you only for the pleasure of Allaah.' He responded by echoing, 'I too like you for the pleasure of Allaah.' I then said, 'Had Rasulullaah ﷺ not instructed me to do this, I would never have done so.'"[^4]
